actions.label: ✔ Modify Selection
actions.tooltip: Changes which frames are selected. All operations work on selected frames only.

actions.label: 💾 Save Frames
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, saves all block and entity changes.

actions.label: ♻ Revert Frames
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, reverts all block and entity changes.

actions.label: 🗑 Remove Frames
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, removes these frames entirely from the animation.

actions.label: ➕ Add New Frame
actions.tooltip: Adds a frame inserted at the frames selected, and defaults to the end of the animation if none are selected. Consecutive frames are treated as groups.

actions.label: ↕ Move Frames
actions.tooltip: Moves each selected frame by a specified offset.

actions.label: 🗐 Duplicate Frames
actions.tooltip: Inserts a duplicate frame at each selected frame, retaining the order of consecutive frames.

actions.label: 📸 Save Camera for Frames
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, saves relative to your closest selected frame.

actions.label: 🎞 Load Camera for Frames
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, shows you a preview of those frames with their durations.

actions.label: 👁 Highlight Cam For Frames
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, shows where their cameras are located.

actions.label: ⌛ Set Frames Duration
actions.tooltip: Operates on all selected frames, changes how long the player is shown a frame before moving to the next one.

actions.label: 🚶 Exit Editor
actions.tooltip: Make sure to save any changes you want to keep!
